english.title: Knowingly implant / attempt to implant into an equine a transponder which is not genuine / has previously been used
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly implanted, or attempted to implant, into an equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), a device which

(A)_[was not a genuine transponder]_
(B)_[had previously been implanted into, or used for, another animal]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 27(a) and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.
english.pointstoprove:

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
